notes.title: Community Event Wrap-Up & Balance Changes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Highest Combo Event Results[/b][/h3][p]
The highest combo community event has ended. Congratulations to all the winners, and thanks to everyone who participated![/p][p][b]Winners:[/b][/p][list][*][p]1st Place — [b]Holy Shite[/b] : 2,052,769,791 (Yes, 2 Billion. Holy shites indeed!)[/p][/*][*][p]2nd Place — [b]borange[/b] : 682,665,984[/p][/*][*][p]3rd Place — [b]miragaia[/b] : 638,164,067[/p][/*][*][p]4th Place — [b]Tabiasmoments[/b] : 625,999,52[/p][/*][*][p]5th Place — [b]SpiritWeasel[/b] : 4,595,616[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489203/87139c3e7546a909cdce00f3468e10b7a9fb8485.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Big shoutout to Tobias, who made a video on how to break the game for insane numbers (with the latest changes, this info should already be dated tho).
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QXVi0Wm8kKU"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Balancing & Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted balance for many Skill cards: [b]any Skill that deals no Damage will now be banished when played.[/b]
This means they can only be used once per combat, making infinite combos no longer viable. Don’t get us wrong — pulling off massive damage is a lot of fun. But maybe that was [i]a bit too much[/i]! We’re preparing so this won’t be possible in future events. (Though we’re sure you’ll still find other ways to break the game. 😉)[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Skill deck[/b] also received adjustments so it’s not as strong right from the start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]El Oso[/b] was having issues with his second ability. For now, he’ll keep only one ability until we can bring it back properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Marking Counter[/b] has been removed from Shop Specials.
It’s no longer possible to add Brands to cards in the shop, but you can still gain Brands as rewards after defeating certain enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Thank You![/b][/h3][p]
Thanks again to everyone who joined the event and played the demo! Watching how you all approached the challenge helped us discover many ways to break the game that maybe [i]shouldn’t[/i] exist — and quite a few bugs we would’ve never found on our own.[/p][p][b]We’d love to hear your thoughts on these changes, so please let us know what you think![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489203/1a09330892cc6c3e12b4fe8cfea4ae7003926059.png"][/img][/p]

The [b]Skill deck[/b] also received adjustments so it’s not as strong right from the start.

notes.title: Demo Update and Highest Combo Community Event!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Demo Update V 0.9.1 – Patch Notes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489203/29a027ddedefafa312f1a661aac23839f32e88a5.png"][/img][b]
[/b][/p][h3][b]🔥 Highest Combo Community Event is Live![/b][/h3][p]
The competition has begun! Climb to the top of the leaderboard with your biggest Combos and win prizes. Join our \[Discord](your link here) to share your scores and claim rewards!
[/p][p][b]⚠️ Important Note[/b]
To make sure the event works properly, we had to [b]reset player run data[/b].
This means the game will start from zero, as if you were playing for the first time.
👉 You can skip the tutorial after the very first conversation, or turn it off anytime in the Settings menu.
[/p][h3][b]⚙️ Changes & Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]Slinky bug[/b]: incremental Patches no longer scale twice.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skills Deck[/b] now includes a starter Trophy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Victory screen[/b] now shows unlocked Decks after winning.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489203/1a09330892cc6c3e12b4fe8cfea4ae7003926059.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Bearly Brave – Demo Update #4
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! And thanks for playing! We’ve been listening to your feedback and patched things up with tweaks, fixes, new boss powers… and even Chuckles joining the fight. Let’s dive into what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance & Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Enemy HP scaling adjusted — enemies now have more HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy base damage now increases to 2 starting at Stage 7 (was Stage 8).[/p][/*][*][p]Whale Patch nerfed: 1 per 2 empty slots → 0.8 per 2 empty slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Gravedigger Skill nerfed.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss powers updated: Grimora, Fix-It Joe, and Melody.[/p][/*][/list][p]And yes, we know the [b]Skill deck is kinda OP[/b] right now… don’t worry, it’ll get some love (and some nerfs) in future patches. 😉[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All Brand rewards now play a sound when the dial is filled.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial skip popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial shortened slightly by removing a few steps.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Chef Comper left to prepare more of his signature Spécialités, so Chuckles is taking his place.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes & Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues with Shamrock Candy.[/p][/*][*][p]Grimble will no longer block your deck in the tutorial (he sends his apologies).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with settings not saving on first launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sounds playing when sound settings were off.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several other errors (and added a few new ones, of course).[/p][/*][*][p]We received several reports about the invisible mouse — we did something for that, hopefully it works now![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Events[/b][/h3][p]Later this week we’re kicking off our first community event![/p][p]Compete for the highest-scoring combo and win prizes. More info coming soon — stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Dev Log[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been working hard on new features for the full version of Bearly Brave! More Patches, boss powers, weapons, cutscenes, endless mode, and even a final boss are on the way.[/p][p]In the coming weeks, we’ll be starting the first rounds of playtesting. If you’d like to take part, keep an eye on our Discord! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Creator Spotlight[/b][/h3][p]We’re always excited to check YouTube for new content about the game, and we try to watch every single video — crossing our fingers that nothing breaks, of course! Thanks to your coverage, we’ve seen a bunch of new players jumping into the demo — welcome aboard and thank you! Here are a few of the latest:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rwm6U0RdgX8&pp=ygUMYmVhcmx5IGJyYXZl"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9sbupLhy0TE&pp=ygUMYmVhcmx5IGJyYXZl"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjfBATfJSqY&pp=ygUMYmVhcmx5IGJyYXZl"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B2Rw2hKa5hU&pp=ygUMYmVhcmx5IGJyYXZl"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L-hdqGvXcws&pp=ygUMYmVhcmx5IGJyYXZl"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489203/1a09330892cc6c3e12b4fe8cfea4ae7003926059.png"][/img][/p]

tags.balance_change: Enemy HP scaling adjusted — enemies now have more HP.
Enemy base damage now increases to 2 starting at Stage 7 (was Stage 8).
Whale Patch nerfed: 1 per 2 empty slots → 0.8 per 2 empty slots.

tags.bug: Grimble will no longer block your deck in the tutorial (he sends his apologies).
Fixed issues with settings not saving on first launch.
Fixed sounds playing when sound settings were off.
Addressed several other errors (and added a few new ones, of course).
We received several reports about the invisible mouse — we did something for that, hopefully it works now!

notes.title: Bearly Brave – Demo Update #3
notes.content:
[p][b]Bearly Brave – Demo Update V0.8.8
[/b][/p][p]Hi everyone! ːsteamhappyː
[/p][p]First of all, thank you so much to everyone who has played the demo so far. Your feedback, bug reports, and creative combos have been incredibly helpful. We've been reading everything and working hard to improve the game with every update.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch brings a round of balancing, fixes, and a little surprise for Jumbo Battery users. Here's what's new:
[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🔧 Balancing & Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Enemy HP reduced by ≈20%[/b] across the board. This should give players more room to experiment with builds and potentially open the door for no-hit runs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix-It Joe[/b] was hitting too hard, so we adjusted his second ability:[/p][list][*][p][i]Before:[/i] Deals +1 Damage for each "Scrap" card in your deck[/p][/*][*][p][i]Now:[/i] Deals +1 Damage if you have "Scrap" cards in your hand[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Some players were getting stuck while using [b]Jumbo Battery[/b] and running out of resources. Now, if you run out of Candies, Discards, and Energy while holding Jumbo Battery... [i]stuff will happen[/i]. (Let us know if it works — yes, it's a pun.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]2 new Patches[/b] have been added to the pool.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Patch Scaling Buffs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gray Plane: 0.2 → 0.25[/p][/*][*][p]Pink Plane: 0.25 → 0.3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pain Wagon[/b] Skill nerfed:[/p][list][*][p]Damage per Brand reduced from 15 → 10
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where enemies looked alive at 0 HP. [i]Wrong game genre, guys.[/i][/p][list][*][p]If this ever happens again, please use the "Copy my build" button in the ESC menu and send us the .res file[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple translation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various smaller bugs (and probably introduced new ones, as tradition dictates)
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]🏆 Community Event Coming Soon![/b][/p][p]We're preparing a community event where players will compete for the [b]highest combo score[/b], with cool prizes for the top players.
Full details coming soon — stay tuned, and start training those combos!
[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for playing and supporting [i]Bearly Brave[/i]!
If you're enjoying the demo, consider leaving a review or joining our [url="https://discord.gg/dz9gpC83hf"]Discord[/url] to share feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489203/1a09330892cc6c3e12b4fe8cfea4ae7003926059.png"][/img][/p]

tags.balance_change: Enemy HP reduced by ≈20% across the board. This should give players more room to experiment with builds and potentially open the door for no-hit runs.

Fix-It Joe was hitting too hard, so we adjusted his second ability:
Before: Deals +1 Damage for each "Scrap" card in your deck
Now: Deals +1 Damage if you have "Scrap" cards in your hand

Some players were getting stuck while using Jumbo Battery and running out of resources. Now, if you run out of Candies, Discards, and Energy while holding Jumbo Battery... stuff will happen. (Let us know if it works — yes, it's a pun.)

tags.feature: 2 new Patches have been added to the pool.

tags.balance_change:
Pain Wagon Skill nerfed:
Damage per Brand reduced from 15 → 10

tags.bug: Fixed a rare bug where enemies looked alive at 0 HP. Wrong game genre, guys.
Fixed various smaller bugs (and probably introduced new ones, as tradition dictates)

notes.title: Bearly Brave – Demo Update (Pre-Launch Patch)
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We want to send a big [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who’s been playing the [i]Bearly Brave[/i] demo during this early preview window. Your feedback has been amazing and incredibly helpful! This update includes a few hotfixes from the past couple days, plus new adjustments in preparation for the [b]public launch of the demo next week[/b].
[/p][h3]Community Videos & Support[/h3][p]We’ve been super lucky to already see some YouTube creators jumping into the demo and sharing their runs! Your videos, streams, and feedback — especially from our Discord community — are a huge source of inspiration.[/p][p]These early impressions are helping us shape [i]Bearly Brave[/i] into something even better, and we’re so grateful to have you all along for the ride.
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsrCALiUTqI"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p]A couple enemies in the demo have been replaced for better overall balance[/p][/*][*][p][b]El Oso's abilities[/b] were fixed and slightly nerfed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bambino’s ability[/b] was fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Text for several [b]scaling Patches[/b] has been rephrased for better clarity[/p][/*][*][p]A few more Patches have been activated for the demo: [b]Pirate Ship[/b] and [b]Picture Pieces[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various [b]audio issues[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a button to access the [b]Quick Reference[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several [b]translation errors[/b] across multiple languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI issues and various [b]typos[/b][/p][/*][*][p]General [b]bug fixes and polish
[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing, testing, and being part of the development.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates next week as we get ready for the [b]official public demo launch[/b]![/p]
